name: Ray&Wall
summary: Hand-only version of Gaze&Wall: a dominant-hand ray points, and a wall moved by the other hand sets the depth.
howItWorks: The dominant hand points a ray (X and Y); the non-dominant hand moves a see-through wall in depth with a downward hand ray. Among the targets on the pointing ray, the one closest to the wall is selected; confirmed with a pinch. Built as a baseline for the gaze techniques.

relationships.note: Both add a depth control to the ray.
